title: selaginella polymorpha
intro: Selaginella polymorpha, commonly known as Spike Moss, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Spike Moss include anti-anxiety, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Spike Moss have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
